blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
As Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, multi-turn interaction attacks have become a significant security challenge. Existing detection methods typically rely on historical context. However, this retrospective logic struggles to identify deep malicious intents that are split across turns to hide future risks.
Inspired by speculative decoding, we propose the Speculative Safety Honeypot (SSH) framework. SSH uses a multi-agent simulation system composed of small LLMs to build an action-level speculate-and-verify workflow. In the speculation stage, SSH predicts future behaviors of the target agent and asynchronously builds a trajectory tree to expose potential risks in advance. In the verification stage, the system uses the target agent’s real actions to calibrate and prune the trajectory tree, effectively reducing false positives.
As a plug-and-playable component, SSH provides existing detectors with rich decision redundancy beyond the current interaction slice. By judging risk based on the evolution of the entire trajectory tree rather than a single point in time, the system reduces the reliance on the absolute precision of individual detection components. This improves the defense resilience and the warning lead-time of agent systems against complex temporal attacks.
blocks.zh:
由于大语言模型(LLM)代理越来越多地被部署在复杂的环境中,多回合交互攻击成为了重大的安全挑战. 现有的检测方法通常依赖于历史背景. 然而,这种回溯性逻辑挣扎着找出相互分割的深层恶意意图来掩盖未来的风险.
在投机解码的启发下,我们提出了"Speculative Security Honeypot"(SSH)框架. SSH使用由小型LLMs组成的多剂模拟系统来构建一个动作层面的推测和验证工作流程. 在投机阶段,SSH预测目标剂的未来行为,并同步地构建出一棵轨迹树来提前暴露出潜在的风险. 在核查阶段,系统利用目标剂的真正动作来校正并放出轨迹树,有效减少假阳性.
作为插件和可播放组件,SSH为现有的探测器提供了超出当前交互切片的丰富的决策冗余. 通过根据整个轨迹树的演化而不是单个时间点来判断风险,系统减少了对单个检测组件绝对精度的依赖. 这提高了防御复原力,提高了对复杂时间攻击的代理系统的预警准备时间.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : User requests an email summary, but is subjected to an IPI attack by a Hacker. SSH speculates on future actions before the Agent acts, revealing high-risk, irrelevant behaviors like money transfers and password changes in the simulation.
blocks.zh: 图一:用户请求电子邮件摘要,但遭到黑客的IPI攻击. SSH在"特工"行动之前推测未来行动,揭示出在模拟中高风险,无关紧要的行为,如资金转移和密码更改等.

blocks.en: Security threats to Large Language Model (LLM) agents are evolving from simple single-turn prompt attacks to complex multi-turn interaction attacks. These threats typically appear in two scenarios: (1) multi-turn jailbreak attacks ( Russinovich et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2025 ) , where malicious users strategically guide an agent over several turns to split attack payloads and bypass safety filters; and (2) multi-turn Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) attacks ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Maloyan and Namiot, 2026 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ) , where an agent triggers harmful actions after retrieving malicious instructions from external sources during a normal conversation. This evolution poses a new challenge to current defense components. While existing methods attempt to use historical context for judgment ( Hines et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Lian et al., 2024 ) , this retrospective detection logic remains insufficient against attacks with temporal stealth. Strict filtering often leads to high false alarms, while relaxed thresholds fail to identify deep malicious intents hidden within split sequences.
blocks.zh: 对大语言模型(LLM)代理的安全威胁正在从简单的单回合即时攻击演变为复杂的多回合交互攻击. 这些威胁通常出现在两种情景中:(1) 多回合越狱攻击(Russinovich等,2025年;Ren等,2024年;Du等,2025年),其中恶意用户从战略上引导一个特工多次转向分拆攻击有效载荷并绕行安全过滤器;和(2) 多回合间接快速注射攻击(Debenderetti等,2024年;Maloyan和Namiot等,2026年;Zhan等,2024年),在正常谈话中从外部来源取回恶意指示后触发了有害行动. 这一演变对目前的防御部分提出了新的挑战. 虽然现有方法试图利用历史背景进行判断(Hines等,2024;Jia等,2025;Shi等,2025;Guo等,2025;Wang等,2025a;Lian等,2024;),但这种追溯检测逻辑仍不足以防止有时间隐蔽的攻击。 严格的过滤往往导致高假警报,而宽松的阈值则无法识别隐藏在分出序列内的深恶意意图.

blocks.en: To tackle this challenge, we draw inspiration from Speculative Decoding ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) and introduce the Speculative Safety Honeypot (SSH) . SSH combines three key simulation components: an Assistant Simulator that mimics the target agent but deliberately remains vulnerable to attacks, quickly revealing potential risks when prompted maliciously; a User Simulator that generates various possible inputs; and a Environment Simulator that creates synthetic tool responses without actually calling external tools, preventing potential harmful actions. These lightweight simulators work together asynchronously to forecast the target agent’s future behaviors. The process is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们从Speculative Decoding(Leviathan等,2023;Xu等,2025a)中汲取了灵感,并引入了Speculative Security Honeypot(SSH). SSH结合了三个关键模拟组件:一个仿真目标剂但刻意保持易受攻击的助理模拟器,在恶意被激起时迅速揭示出潜在的风险;一个生成各种可能输入的用户模拟器;以及一个环境模拟器,生成合成工具响应而无需实际调用外部工具,防止潜在的有害行动. 这些轻量级模拟器同步工作,预测目标剂的未来行为. 这一过程如图1所示。

blocks.en: Specifically, in the speculation drafting stage, we designed a diversity-oriented Beam Search algorithm. By using path branching and behavior clustering, this algorithm maximizes the exploration of the risk space within a limited computational budget. Then, in the Verification stage, the system introduces an asynchronous calibration logic. By comparing the real-time behavior of the target agent with the speculation tree, the system dynamically prunes invalid paths that deviate from the facts. We then leverage the existing detectors within the original Agent system, such as harmful content classifiers or external LLM-based judges, to perform risk assessments on the leaf nodes. The risk score is defined as the proportion of leaf nodes identified as risky; an alert is triggered once this score exceeds a predefined threshold.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,在推测起草阶段,我们设计了一个面向多样性的Beam搜索算法. 通过使用路径分支和行为集群,这个算法在有限的计算预算范围内最大限度地探索了风险空间. 然后,在核查阶段,系统引入了同步校正逻辑. 通过将目标代理的实时行为与投机树进行比较,系统能动态地推倒偏离事实的无效路径. 然后,我们利用原始代理系统中的现有探测器,如有害内容分类器或外部基于LLM的法官,对叶子节点进行风险评估。 风险分被定义为被确定为有风险的叶子节点的比例;一旦该分数超过预先设定的阈值,就会触发警报.

blocks.en: A key advantage of SSH is that it provides existing detectors with rich predictive information. Compared to judging a single isolated node, the speculation tree offers stronger decision redundancy. Because the defense system can judge based on the evolution of risk trends across the entire tree rather than a momentary output, it reduces the reliance on the absolute precision of individual detection components. This improves the defense resilience of agent systems against complex multi-turn attacks.
blocks.zh: SSH的一个关键优势是它为现有的探测器提供了丰富的预测信息. 与判断单个孤立的节点相比,投机树提供了更强的决策冗余. 由于防御系统可以根据整个树上的风险趋势的演变而不是一瞬间输出来判断,因此减少了对单个探测组件绝对精度的依赖. 这提高了代理系统抵御复杂多回合攻击的防御韧性.

blocks.en: The primary contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We propose the Speculative Safety Honeypot, the first framework that shifts LLM agent defense from retrospective context analysis to proactive future speculation. By simulating potential interaction trajectories, SSH uncovers hidden malicious intents before they manifest in the real environment. • We introduce the diversity-orientated Beam Search. This design enables the efficient exploration of diverse and corner-case risk trajectories within a limited computational budget, providing high decision redundancy for downstream safety detectors. • Experiments demonstrate that SSH enhances agent resilience. In complex multi-turn scenarios, SSH-enhanced systems achieve a 0% ASR against both jailbreak and indirect injection, while mitigating the degradation in utility caused by existing defensive methods.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出"Speculative Security Honeypot",这是第一个将LLM代理防御从回溯性上下文分析转向主动性未来推测的框架. 通过模拟潜在的相互作用轨迹,SSH揭示出隐藏的恶意意图,然后在真实环境中显现出来. ^ 我们介绍了以多样性为导向的Beam搜索。 这种设计能够在有限的计算预算范围内有效探索各种和角落式的风险轨迹,为下游安全探测器提供高决定冗余。 实验表明,SSH可增强剂的抗御能力。 在复杂的多回合假想中,SSH增强的系统实现了对越狱和间接注射的百分之零的ASR,同时缓解了由现有防御方法导致的功用退化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Speculation Techniques
blocks.zh: 2.1 投机技术

blocks.en: Speculative Decoding (SD) ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) accelerates autoregressive inference by validating drafts from a small model in parallel. This framework has been extended to the safety domain: SSD ( Wang et al., 2025b ) leverages a safety expert to guide safe token generation.
blocks.zh: 分光解码(SD)(Leviathan等,2023;Xu等,2025a)通过并行验证从一个小模型得到的草稿来加速自回推论. 这一框架被扩展至安全领域:SSD(Wang等,2025b)利用一名安全专家指导安全信使生成.

blocks.en: Dynamic Speculative Agent Planning (DSP) ( Guan et al., 2025 ) applies the speculative framework to agentic workflows by using a small model to draft multi-step actions for large model verification. Similarly, Speculative Action ( Ye et al., 2025 ) predicts environment states and user actions to allow continuous planning, reducing API latency. In the reasoning domain, SpecReason ( Pan et al., 2025 ) utilizes a lightweight model to generate intermediate steps, where the base model performs semantic utility checks and corrective actions only when necessary.
blocks.zh: 动态分光剂规划(DSP)(Guan等,2025年)通过使用一个小模型来起草大型分光模型核查的多步骤行动,将投机框架应用于分光活性工作流程. 同样地,Speculative Action(Ye等,2025年)预测环境状态和用户行动,允许持续规划,减少API延迟. 在推理领域,SpecReason(Pan等,2025年)利用轻量级模型来生成中间步骤,基础模型只在必要时进行语义效用检查并进行纠正.

blocks.en: These methodologies elevate speculative techniques from the token level to a more granular action level, exploring the speculation of LLM plans, reasoning steps, API responses, and user requests. Such advancements demonstrate that action-level speculation via smaller models is viable, providing strong empirical support for the feasibility of SSH.
blocks.zh: 这些方法将投机技术从象征性水平提升到更细小的行动水平,探索LLM计划的投机,推理步骤,API响应,用户请求. 这些进展表明,通过较小的模型进行行动层面的投机是可行的,为SSH的可行性提供了强有力的经验支持.

blocks.en: 2.2 Multi-turn Attacks
blocks.zh: 2.2 多回合攻击

blocks.en: Direct Multi-Turn Jailbreak attacks exploit the sequential nature of LLM interactions to bypass guardrails robust against single-turn queries. Unlike static injections, these attacks iteratively steer models toward compromised states. For instance, Crescendo ( Russinovich et al., 2025 ) utilizes benign probes to accumulate harmful context, while ASJA ( Du et al., 2025 ) manipulates dialogue history to shift self-attention away from safety-critical tokens. Furthermore, AMA ( Wu et al., 2025 ) employs cross-domain analogies to camouflage intent. These methods highlight a ”context-drift” vulnerability where cumulative semantic weight overrides initial safety alignment.
blocks.zh: 直接的多轮断狱攻击利用LLM相互作用的相继性质来绕过坚固的防护道来抵御单转询问. 与静态注射不同的是,这些攻击迭代地将模型引向被破坏的状态. 例如,Crescendo(Russinovich等,2025年)利用良性探测器来积累有害的环境,而ASJA(Du等,2025年)则操纵对话历史来改变自我意识,使其脱离安全的关键标志。 此外,AMA(Wu等,2025年)使用跨域类比来伪装意图。 这些方法凸显出一种“文字-干法”的脆弱性,即累积语义重量高于最初的安全相接。

blocks.en: Indirect Multi-Turn Injection (IPI) exploits the trust agents place in external feedback. Benchmarks such as InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , and STAC ( Li et al., 2025 ) show that hidden instructions in documents or tool outputs can compromise workflows without direct user input. In multi-step tasks, these poisoned observations disrupt the agent’s reasoning cycle, gradually corrupting its internal planning. For example, Johnson et al. (2025) demonstrate how modifying HTML can iteratively steer web agents toward malicious goals.
blocks.zh: 间接多轮注入(IPI)利用信任代理在外部反馈中的位置. InjecAgent等基准(Zhan等,2024年),代理 Dojo (Debenedetti等,2024年),和STAC (Li等,2025年)显示,文档或工具输出中隐藏的指令可以在没有直接用户输入的情况下折中工作流程. 在多步骤的任务中,这些被毒害的观察扰乱了特工的推理周期,逐渐地腐蚀了其内部规划. 例如,Johnson等人(2025年)展示了修改HTML如何能迭代地将网络代理引导到恶意目标.

blocks.en: Limitations of Existing Defenses While recent research has begun to address adversarial attacks in complex multi-turn interactions, existing solutions, including both prompting methods ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Hines et al., 2024 ) and external detectors ( An et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , predominantly focus on defending within the immediate context. These methods typically lack predictive modeling of future execution paths, which limits their capacity for a more proactive defense strategy.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近已开始研究复杂的多回合互动中的对抗性攻击问题,但现有解决办法,包括促发方法(Shi等,2025;Yu等,2026;Hines等,2024;An等,2025;Zhu等,2025;Hou等,2025;Wang等,2024;Wang等,2024),主要侧重于眼前背景下的防御。 这些方法通常缺乏对未来行刑路径的预测模型,这限制了它们采取更主动防御战略的能力.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: SSH employs a Multi-Agent System (MAS) composed of a group of LLMs to asynchronously speculate on potential future actions of the Target Agent. This process generates a Speculation Tree, where the leaf nodes are evaluated for high-risk behaviors. Once the Target Agent produces a real-world action, the tree is pruned accordingly, and the risk ratio of the remaining subtree’s leaf nodes is calculated. If this ratio exceeds a predefined threshold, the system triggers an alert to guide, resample, or directly terminate the target agent’s execution. In the following sections, we provide a detailed description of the four key components: MAS, speculation, verification, and training.
blocks.zh: SSH使用由一组LLMs组成的多代理系统,以同步推测目标代理未来可能采取的行动. 这个过程会产生一棵花序树,其中叶节被评价为高风险行为. 一旦目标代理产生出真实世界的动作,树会被相继被打出,剩下的亚树叶节点的风险比被计算出. 如果这个比值超过预先设定的阈值,系统会触发一个警告来引导,再现,或直接终止目标代理的执行. 在以下各节中,我们详细描述了四个关键组成部分:MAS、推测、核查和培训。

Built on an uncensored LLM with Multi-LoRA, the User, Assistant, and Tool simulators construct a speculative tree to explore potential outcomes. Existing detectors then inspect leaf nodes for high-risk branches. Once the target Agent generates its action, the tree is pruned and a risk score is calculated. The right panel illustrates the Beam Search: letters denote unique actions, gray boxes represent action clusters, and purple numbers indicate the Round-Robin selection order.

blocks.en: 3.1 Construction of the Simulation System
blocks.zh: 3.1 模拟系统的建造

blocks.en: The core of the SSH framework is a MAS designed to speculate on the future behaviors of the target agent. The system consists of three LLM-based simulators: • Assistant Simulator Acting as a proxy for the target agent, it uses a model without safety alignment. Its high sensitivity helps expose potential risks early. • User Simulator It generates diverse and ambiguous interaction intents. By using a model without safety alignment, it captures a wider range of edge-case inputs that might bypass standard filters. • Environment Simulator It provides synthetic feedback for tools, MCP ( Anthropic, 2024 ) , databases, and 3rd-party agents. This avoids real-world execution, ensuring the simulation process remains isolated and harmless. The MAS architecture is decentralized. The interaction sequence and turn-taking logic between these three simulators are governed by a predefined communication protocol (refer to Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: SSH框架的核心是用于推测目标代理未来行为的MAS. 系统由三个基于LLM的模拟器组成: • 助理模拟器作为目标剂的代用,它使用一种没有安全对接的模型. 它的高度敏感性有助于及早揭露潜在的风险。 • 用户模拟器 它产生多样而模棱两可的互动意图。 通过使用一个没有安全对接的模型,它能捕捉到范围更广的可以绕过标准过滤器的边框输入. • 环境模拟器 它为工具,MCP(Anthropic,2024年),数据库,和三党代理提供合成回馈. 这避免了现实世界的行刑,确保了模拟过程仍然孤立而无害. blocks.en: 3.2 Speculative Trajectory Tree Drafting
blocks.zh: 3.2 采样轨迹树起草

blocks.en: Whenever the target agent starts to generate, SSH is triggered to perform an asynchronous speculation. It clones the current message list from the target agent and utilizes it as the foundation to construct a comprehensive speculation.
blocks.zh: 当目标代理开始生成时,SSH被触发来进行同步的猜测. 它从目标代理中复制了当前消息列表,并将其作为构建全面猜测的基础.

blocks.en: To maximize risk exposure within a limited computational budget, SSH employs a diversity-oriented Beam Search algorithm. Unlike traditional speculative decoding that aims for high hit rates, our goal is to increase path coverage to discover high-risk corner cases.
blocks.zh: 为了在有限的计算预算范围内最大限度地扩大风险敞口,SSH采用了面向多样性的Beam搜索算法. 与传统的以高打击率为目标的投机性解码不同,我们的目标是增加路径覆盖面以发现高风险角落病例.

blocks.en: We define each message (e.g., Assistant tool calls, Environment simulator feedback, or User requests) as a node within the Speculation Tree. The search process is governed by two critical hyperparameters: the sampling budget M M , which dictates the total speculative bandwidth (tree width) at each level, and the maximum depth D D , representing the number of sequential speculation steps.
blocks.zh: 我们定义每个消息(如助理工具呼叫,环境模拟器反馈,或用户请求)为Speculation树内的节点. 搜索过程由两个关键的超参数规范:采样预算M M,它规定每个级别的总投机带宽(树宽)和最大深度D D,代表相继推测步骤的数量.

blocks.en: We model agent interactions as an alternation between two types of states. Key nodes include user requests and assistant actions; since these nodes have high branching potential, the algorithm triggers sampling and path expansion here. Regular nodes include tool responses and logical summaries; these are typically deterministic extensions of preceding actions, so the algorithm performs only a single sample without further expansion. At each key node , the process unfolds as Algorithm 1 :

blocks.en: Branching and Sampling . The algorithm initiates path expansion by sampling candidate nodes based on a quota assigned in the preceding level. For the root node, the initial quota is set to M M . For all subsequent nodes, the number of samples is dynamically determined by the selection results of the previous iteration.

blocks.en: Bi-level Shuffling. To eliminate potential sampling bias and ensure fairness during selection, a bi-level randomization is applied to the clustered results. The algorithm first shuffles the order of the clusters themselves and subsequently shuffles the intra-cluster order of individual nodes.
blocks.zh: 双层舒夫林. 为了消除潜在的采样偏差,并确保选取过程中的公正性,对分组结果实行双层随机化. 算法首先洗涤了集群本身的顺序,后又洗涤了单个节点的集群内部顺序.

blocks.en: Round-Robin Selection and Re-allocation. To finalize the candidates for the next depth, nodes are selected via a Round-Robin process across all clusters until the total budget of M M is reached. This mechanism inherently rebalances the speculative focus: redundant nodes within majority (large) clusters are likely to be pruned, while nodes from minority (small) clusters may be selected multiple times. Consequently, these minority nodes receive a higher sampling quota in the next iteration. By effectively down-sampling common behaviors and amplifying rare ones, the algorithm is forced to explore more diverse and corner-case interaction trajectories.
blocks.zh: 圆罗宾选取再分配. 为了最终确定下一个深度的候选人,通过回合-Robin进程在所有分组中选择节点,直到达到M M的总预算. 这种机制在本质上重新平衡了投机焦点:多数(大)集群内的冗余节点很可能被挤出,而少数(小)集群的节点则可能多次被选中. 因此,这些少数民族节点在下次重复时获得较高的采样配额。 通过有效下取样常见行为并扩展稀有行为,该算法被迫去探索更多样化和角相间的相互作用轨迹.

blocks.en: Given that regular nodes , such as environment responses or logical summaries, typically exhibit high determinism, we bypass the complex Beam Search strategy for these instances. Instead, the system performs a single sample to extend the speculative path.
blocks.zh: 鉴于常规节点,如环境反应或逻辑摘要,通常表现出高度的确定性,我们绕过复杂的Beam搜索策略来应对这些情况。 相反,这个系统进行一个单一的样本来扩展推测路径.

blocks.en: 3.3 Asynchronous Verification and Risk Scoring
blocks.zh: 3.3 同步核实和风险测定

blocks.en: The verification mechanism utilizes the actual actions produced by the target agent to validate the speculation tree. This process aims to narrow the scope of speculative results, thereby enabling a more precise assessment of risk probabilities.
blocks.zh: 核查机制利用目标代理人所产生的实际行动来验证投机树. 这一进程旨在缩小投机结果的范围,从而能够更准确地评估风险概率。

blocks.en: Tree Pruning Strategy To align the speculation with real-time execution, we match the Target Agent’s actual action against the M M speculative candidates using the Behavioral Clustering logic described in Section 3.2 . For function calls, we perform an exact match on both the function names and their respective arguments. For textual responses, we calculate similarity via SimHash. If the actual action matches one of the M M speculated behaviors, we prune the speculation tree to retain only the subtree corresponding to the matched cluster. In cases where no match is found, the original tree is preserved to serve as a reference for potential future risks.
blocks.zh: 树丛策略 为了将猜测与实时执行相配合,我们用第3.2节所描述的行为组合逻辑来配合目标代理人对M M投机候选人的实际行动。 对于函数调用,我们对函数名称和各自的参数进行精确匹配. 对于文字反应,我们通过SimHash计算出相似性. 如果实际动作符合 M M 所推测的行为之一,我们推倒了投机树,只保留对应集群的子树. 在找不到匹配的情况下,保留了原始树,作为未来潜在风险的参考.

This step leverages existing detectors within the Agent’s original system, such as harmful content classifiers or an external LLM-based judge. The complete message list of each speculated trajectory (from the root to the leaf) is serialized into a string and fed into the detector for binary classification. Where necessary, truncation is applied to accommodate context limits. Each leaf node is thus classified as either risk or safe . blocks.en: 3.4 Differentiated Alignment Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.4 差别调整战略

blocks.en: The effectiveness of SSH stems from a balance between simulation fidelity and risk sensitivity. To ensure that speculative paths remain within the execution space of the target agent while being more susceptible to induced violations in adversarial scenarios, we propose a Differentiated Alignment Strategy. By calibrating behavioral distributions, this strategy intentionally enhances the vulnerability of SSH in adversarial environments to maximize risk exposure and early warning capabilities.
blocks.zh: SSH的有效性源于模拟忠诚度和风险敏感性之间的平衡. 为确保投机路径留在目标代理人的执行空间内,同时在对抗性情况下更容易被诱发侵权行为,我们提出了差别化的对接战略。 通过校正行为分布,这一策略有意地提高了SSH在对抗性环境中的脆弱性,以将风险暴露和预警能力最大化.

blocks.en: To improve fidelity, we employ Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to ensure the Assistant Simulator within SSH covers the execution habits of the target agent. We select high-quality instructions from open-source datasets ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) , such as Toucan ( Xu et al., 2025b ) and collect the raw response trajectories of the target agent as training data. During data construction, we remove long CoT (i.e., the content in the ⟨ think ⟩ \langle\text{think}\rangle tags) while preserving potential error patterns to achieve a precise approximation of the target agent’s full behavioral distribution.
blocks.zh: 为了提高忠诚度,我们使用"监督"(Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT))来确保SSH内部的助理模拟器覆盖目标代理的行刑习惯. 我们从开源数据集(Liu等,2025;Wang等,2025c等)中选择高品质的指令,并收集目标剂的原始响应轨迹作为培训数据. 在数据构建过程中, 我们删除了长 COT( 即 QQ 思考\ langle\text{think\rangle tags) 中的内容, 同时保留潜在的出错模式, 以准确接近目标代理的全部行为分布 。

blocks.en: To enhance sensitivity, we designed a benign injection data synthesis scheme based on environmental consistency. In this approach, a normal instruction from one sample is treated as a payload and embedded into the tool-return results of another environment-compatible sample using system-level templates. By truncating the original conversation flow and concatenating the execution logic of the payload instruction, we simulate the process in which an agent deviates from its primary task due to misleading tool feedback. We then used this data to SFT the assistant simulator in SSH.
blocks.zh: 为了提高敏感性,我们根据环境一致性设计了一个良性注射数据综合计划。 在这种方法中,一个样本的正常指令作为有效载荷处理,并被嵌入到另一个环境相容样本的工具回放结果中,使用系统级模板. 通过截断原对话流并调和有效载荷指令的执行逻辑,我们模拟了由于误导性工具反馈而使特工偏离其主要任务的过程. 然后我们用这个数据 在SSH的助理模拟器SFT。

blocks.en: Regarding the training data for the Tool and User Simulator, we directly reuse the filtered Toucan dataset by switching the fine-tuning target from the assistant field to the tool or user fields, respectively. This approach enhances the Tool Simulator’s ability to emulate authentic tool outputs and improves the User Simulator’s capability to generate context-aware queries based on available tool lists.
blocks.zh: 关于工具和用户模拟器的培训数据,我们直接重新使用经过过滤的Toucan数据集,将微调目标分别从助理字段改为工具或用户字段。 这种方法增强了工具模拟器模拟真实工具输出的能力,并提升了用户模拟器根据可用工具列表生成上下文感查询的能力.

blocks.en: The three simulators are trained via LoRA-based SFT. Rather than merging the resulting LoRA weights into the backbone, we deploy them as concurrent Multi-LoRA adapters integrated with a single shared LLM ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . This architectural choice reduces the GPU memory footprint and enables efficient context switching between different simulator roles within the SSH framework. Please refer to the Appendix B for more details.
blocks.zh: 三个模拟器通过基于LORA的SFT进行训练. 我们不是将由此产生的LORA权重合并到骨干上,而是将其作为多LORA适配器,与单一共享的LLM(Wang等,2023年)相融合。 这种建筑选择会减少GPU内存足迹并使得SSH框架内不同模拟器角色之间的上下文切换高效. 详见附录B。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: 4.2.1 SSH Effectively Defends Against IPI
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 SSH 有效防御IPI

blocks.en: Experimental results on AgentDojo demonstrate the effectiveness of SSH against IPI. Instead of directly terminating the agents generation upon reaching the risk threshold, we implement a resampling strategy. Specifically, if the risk score of an action branch speculated by SSH exceeds the safety threshold, a resampling process is triggered until an action falls outside the high-risk branches. This process is repeated for a maximum of five iterations, after which the generation is interrupted if no safe action is found. For this experiment, the beam search width was set to 8, with 4 nodes selected for expansion at each step.
blocks.zh: Agent Dojo的实验结果证明了SSH对抗IPI的效果. 我们没有在达到风险阈值时直接终止物剂生成,而是执行再生战略。 具体来说,如果SSH所推测的某个动作分支的风险分数超过安全阈值,则会触发一个再生过程,直到某个动作落入了高风险分支之外. 这个过程最多重复了5个迭代,之后如果找不到安全动作,则会中断生成. 对于这一实验,梁搜索宽被设定为8个,每个步骤选择了4个节点进行扩展.

blocks.en: SSH achieves the lowest Attack Success Rate (ASR). Table 1 reports the performance of SSH when integrated with PromptGuard and Judger. The results indicate that regardless of the underlying detector, SSH achieves a perfect 0% ASR, providing robust protection against adversarial injections.
blocks.zh: SSH实现最低攻击成功率(ASR). 表1汇报了SSH与PowerGuard和Judger合并后的业绩。 结果显示,无论背后的探测器如何,SSH都实现了完美的0%ASR,为对抗性注射提供了有力的防护.

blocks.en: SSH reduces the performance requirements for individual detectors. As shown in Table 1 , PromptGuard and Judger yield average ASRs of 12.25% and 10.48% respectively when acting as independent defenses, illustrating their limited efficacy in isolation. By integrating SSH, the ASR for both detectors drops to 0%. This synergy substantially alleviates the pressure on detector development in two ways: it reduces training complexity, where heavy resources are often required to marginally lower ASR, and it eases deployment constraints. Even a lightweight 86M detector can achieve 0% ASR when augmented by SSH, eliminating the need to deploy larger, more resource-intensive models for minor security gains.
blocks.zh: SSH降低了单个探测器的性能要求. 如表1所示,PoanGuard和Judger在作为独立辩护人时平均获得12.25%和10.48%的ASR,说明它们在孤立情况下的效能有限。 通过集成SSH,两个探测器的ASR都下降到了0%. 这种协同作用以两种方式大大地减轻了探测器开发的压力:它减少了培训的复杂性,因为培训往往需要大量资源来略为降低主动报告率,它减轻了部署方面的限制。 即使一个轻量级的86M探测器在被SSH所增强时也能实现0%的ASR,从而无需为小的安全增益部署更大,资源更密集的模型.

blocks.en: SSH improves Utility. Compared to prompt-based defense methods, detectors typically exert a more severe negative impact on utility. For instance, in the travel scenario, PromptGuard reduces Utility under Attack (UA) by over 20%. The combination of SSH and the resampling strategy mitigates this impact, leading to an average UA improvement of 8.12%. Case studies reveal that PromptGuard primarily identifies the presence of injected text rather than whether the LLM was successfully compromised, which accounts for its lower baseline UA. In contrast, Judger focuses on whether the assistant’s action deviates from the user’s request, resulting in a higher baseline UA and even more clear utility gains when integrated with SSH.
blocks.zh: SSH改进了功能. 相较于即时防御方法,探测器通常会对效用产生更严重的负面影响. 例如,在旅行情况下, " 快速护卫 " 将 " 攻击 " 下的效用减少20%以上。 SSH与再生策略的结合减轻了这种影响,导致普遍获得率平均改善8.12%. 案例研究表明,PowerGuard主要查明的是注入文本的存在,而不是LLM是否成功失密,这是其基准普遍获得率较低的原因。 相比之下,Judger则专注于助理的行为是否偏离了用户的要求,导致更高的基准普遍获得率,并在与SSH整合时更清晰的效用收益.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 SSH Effectively Defends Against Multi-turn Jailbreak Attacks
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 安全孕产 有效防范多轮越狱袭击

blocks.en: The success of ActorAttack depends heavily on the capabilities of the attacking LLM; while safety-aligned models often refuse to initiate attacks, weaker models typically fail to design effective attack paths. Therefore, we utilize Dolphin - X1 - 8B , a uncensored LLM, as the attacker for this experiment. In addition to ASR, we report the Risk Exposure Rate to evaluate the sensitivity of SSH.
blocks.zh: ActorAttack的成功很大程度上取决于攻击LLM的能力;虽然安全相通的模型往往拒绝发动攻击,而较弱的模型通常未能设计出有效的攻击路径. 因此,我们利用海豚-X1-8B,一种未经审查的LLM,作为这次实验的攻击者. 除了ASR之外,我们还报告风险暴露率,以评估SSH的敏感性.

blocks.en: First, SSH exhibits high sensitivity to jailbreak attempts. Table 2 shows that even with a single sample ( M = 1 M=1 ), the Risk Exposure Rate reaches 84.5%, demonstrating that SSH can effectively identify jailbreak signals. Notably, the attack is 100% defended when the number of samples M M is increased to 5. This result suggests that SSH provides comprehensive protection against sophisticated multi-turn attacks without necessitating prohibitive computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 首先,SSH显示出对越狱企图的高度敏感性. 表2显示,即使有单一样本(M=1 M=1),风险暴露率也达到了84.5%,表明SSH能够有效识别越狱信号. 值得注意的是,当MM样本数量增加到5个时,袭击得到100%的防御。 这一结果表明,SSH提供全面的保护,防止复杂的多回合攻击,而无需高昂的计算间接费用。

blocks.en: Furthermore, we observe diminishing marginal returns regarding the Risk Exposure Rate as M M increases. On the HarmBench subset, increasing M M from 1 to 3 yields a substantial 10% gain in exposure rate, whereas the improvement from M = 4 M=4 to M = 5 M=5 narrows significantly to only 1%.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们观察到,随着MM的增加,风险接触率的边际收益正在减少。 在Harm Bench子集中,将MM从1增加到3,使接触率大幅提高10%,而从M=4M=4到M=5M=5的改善明显地缩小到只有1%。

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 SSH对目标物剂的作用

blocks.en: To assess utility and interference, we evaluated SSH on BFCL-v3 (long-range tool-calling) and XSTest (benign requests with sensitive keywords). Experiments utilized a sampling budget of M = 8 M=8 and depth D = 4 D=4 , with Judger as the base detector.
blocks.zh: 为了评估效用和干扰,我们在BFCL-v3(远程工具调用)和XS Test(带有敏感关键词的原始请求)上评价了SSH. 实验采用M=8 M=8和深度D=4 D=4的采样预算,以Judger为基准探测器.

blocks.en: Experimental results in Table 3 indicate that SSH imposes no negative impact on the utility of Qwen3-235B during BFCL-v3 tasks. We attribute the minor fluctuations in performance metrics to sampling stochasticity rather than systematic bias. Statistical results in Figure 3 further confirm that the average risk scores generated by SSH on BFCL-v3 remain near zero, with no speculative paths exceeding the alert threshold. This demonstrates that SSH maintains an exceptionally low false-positive rate under standard task scenarios.
blocks.zh: 表3的实验结果表明,SSH在BFCL-v3任务期间对Qune3-235B的用途没有产生任何负面影响. 我们把性能指标的微小波动归因于取样的花样性,而不是系统的偏差。 图3的统计结果还进一步证实,SSH在BFCL-v3上产生的平均风险分数仍然接近于零,没有超过警戒阈值的投机路径. 这表明,在标准任务设想下,SSH的虚假阳性率非常低。

blocks.en: Results on XSTest follow a similar trend: Qwen3-235B’s refusal rate remains at 0% post-deployment, indicating no erroneous interceptions. While Figure 3 shows slightly higher average risk scores for XSTest compared to BFCL-v3, the alert rate remains 0% across all samples. This demonstrates that SSH effectively distinguishes sensitive terminology from malicious intent, preserving service availability without compromising security.
blocks.zh: XSTest的结果也呈现出类似趋势: Quen3-235 (中文(简体) ). B的拒绝率保持在部署后的0%,表明没有错误的拦截。 虽然图3显示XSTest的平均风险分数略高于BFCL-v3,但在所有样本中,警戒率仍然为0%. 这表明SSH有效地区分了敏感术语和恶意意图,在不损害安全的情况下保留了服务可用性.

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Risk Score Distribution Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 风险分数分布分析

blocks.en: Figure 3 reports average risk scores and alert rates for AgentDojo and ActorAttack. Using M = 8 , D = 4 M=8,D=4 in speculation-only mode, we compare full-dataset averages against non-zero risk means to analyze alert intensity. Across all metrics, adversarial datasets consistently yield higher risk scores than utility benchmarks (BFCL-v3, XSTest), confirming the discriminative precision of SSH.
blocks.zh: 图3报告了Dojo特工和ActorAttack的平均风险分数和警报率。 使用 M = 8, D = 4 M = 8, D = 4 在只假设模式下,我们比较全数据集平均值与非零风险手段,以分析警报强度. 在所有衡量标准中,对抗性数据集的风险分数始终高于公用基准(BFCL-v3,XSTest),证实了SSH的差别精确性.

blocks.en: In AgentDojo, risk scores remain near zero initially as attacks are only triggered upon reaching later adversarial injection points. This delayed activation explains the lower overall average score and alert frequency compared to ActorAttack, where malicious intent is often more immediate.
blocks.zh: 在Agent Dojo中,风险分数最初仍然接近于零,因为只有到了后期对抗性注射点才会被触发. 这种延迟活化现象解释了总体平均得分和警报频率低于ActorAttack的原因,ActorAttack的恶意意图往往更直接.

blocks.en: 4.2.5 Ablation Study: Beam Search vs. Top-P Sampling for Enhanced Diversity
blocks.zh: 4.2.5 校正研究:Beam Search vs. Top-P 为增强多样性而取样

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our search strategy, we conduct an ablation study comparing Beam Search with Top-P sampling. The results consistently demonstrate that Beam Search provides a more robust foundation for threat detection, outperforming Top-P sampling in both risk exposure and hit rates across all evaluated benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们搜索战略的有效性,我们进行了一项将Beam搜索和Top-P取样进行比较的消毒研究。 调查结果始终表明,Beam搜索为发现威胁提供了更坚实的基础,在所有评估的基准中,在风险暴露和受打击率方面都比Top-P取样要好。

blocks.en: Figure 4 reveals that Beam Search identifies security threats more effectively than Top-P sampling on both AgentDojo and ActorAttack. This performance gap suggests that the structured, deterministic exploration inherent in Beam Search is better suited for surfacing adversarial intent than the stochastic nature of Top-P sampling.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,Beam Search在Dojo探员和ActorAttack身上比Top-P取样更有效地识别安全威胁。 这一性能差距表明,比起Top-P采样的花样特征,Beam Search中固有的结构化,决定性的探索更适合表面对抗意图.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we observed a disparity in the Hit Rate between different attack modalities. In the tool-calling environments of AgentDojo, the hit rate for action speculation reaches 47.2% at M = 4 M=4 ; however, this value drops to a mere 8% on the text-based jailbreaks of ActorAttack. This sharp contrast implies that in the context of ActorAttack, the internal verification mechanism is bypassed, forcing the defense to rely almost exclusively on the diverse risk exposure provided by speculative branches.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们看到不同攻击方式之间的命中率差异。 在Agent Dojo的工具召唤环境中,动作投机的命中率以M=4 M=4的速度达到47.2%;然而,在ActorAttack基于文字的越狱事件上,这个值只降到了8%. 这种尖锐的对比意味着,在ActorAttack的背景下,内部核查机制被绕过,迫使辩护方几乎完全依赖于投机分支提供的各种风险敞口.

blocks.en: Ultimately, these findings confirm that Beam Search facilitates a more diverse search space than Top-P sampling. This enhanced diversity directly bolsters defensive efficacy, as it enables the system to explore a broader spectrum of potential trajectories and intercept latent risks that might otherwise remain undetected.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,这些发现证实Beam Search比Top-P采样更能促进更多样化的搜索空间. 这种多样性的增强直接增强了防御效力,因为它使该系统能够探索更广泛的潜在轨迹并拦截可能仍未被察觉的潜在风险。

blocks.en: 4.2.6 Scaling Law of Hit Rate on Multi-step Trajectories
blocks.zh: 4.2.6 提高多步轨道命中率法

blocks.en: To further investigate the speculative accuracy of SSH over extended interaction sequences, we conduct a scaling analysis of the hit rate using the BFCL-v3 benchmark. Given that BFCL-v3 comprises a significant volume of tasks requiring agents to invoke multiple tools serially, it serves as an ideal testbed for multi-step trajectory analysis. Specifically, we compare the complete execution traces of the agents against the first search tree speculated by SSH, calculating the hit rate across tree depths of 2, 3, 4, and 5.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步调查SSH相对于扩展交互序列的投机精度,我们使用BFCL-v3基准对命中率进行比例分析. 鉴于BFCL-v3包含大量任务,要求代理机构连续地引用多套工具,它成为多步轨迹分析的理想试验床. 具体地说,我们比较了特工们的完整行刑痕迹与SSH所推测的第一个搜索树,计算出跨树深2,3,4和5的命中率.

blocks.en: The results, as illustrated in the fifth sub-graph of Figure 4 , reveal that SSH maintains a high hit rate even across long-range trajectory chains. For instance, at a depth of 5, the hit rate for M = 16 M=16 remains close to 70%. Although diminishing marginal returns are evident as the sampling budget increases, it is important to note that the speculation process in SSH does not necessitate perfect alignment with the target agent’s exact path. Instead, a hit rate of approximately 70% provides a sufficient foundation for effective pruning of the search tree, thereby narrowing the scope of risk assessment.
blocks.zh: 如图4第五个子图所示,这些结果表明,即使跨越了远程轨道链,SSH仍然保持着高命中率。 例如,在深度5下,M=16M=16的命中率仍然接近70%。 虽然随着抽样预算的增加,边际回报率明显下降,但必须指出,SSH的投机过程并不需要与目标代理人的确切路径完全一致。 相反,大约70%的打击率为有效打通搜索树提供了充分的基础,从而缩小了风险评估的范围。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced Speculative Safety Honeypot, a proactive defense framework that shifts LLM agent protection from retrospective context analysis to predictive future speculation. By integrating lightweight simulators with a diversity-oriented beam search, SSH effectively uncovers hidden malicious intents across multi-turn interactions while maintaining system utility. Experimental results validate that SSH consistently eliminates attack success rates (0% ASR) for both jailbreak and indirect injection threats.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了Speculative Secretary Honeypot,这是一个主动防御框架,将LLM剂保护从回溯性上下文分析转向预测未来猜测. 通过将轻量级模拟器与面向多样性的光束搜索相结合,SSH在维持系统实用性的同时,有效地揭示了多回合互动中隐藏的恶意意图. 实验结果证实,SSH一贯消除越狱和间接注射威胁的成功率(0%ASR)。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We discuss the limitations of this work from the following two perspectives. 1. Computational and Environmental Impacts : The primary trade-off of SSH is the additional compute required for parallel speculation. While we use a lightweight 3B model with Multi-LoRA (adding only  1.3% parameter overhead relative to the 235B target), the GPU memory and power consumption for running M = 5 M=5 concurrent branches are non-negligible. In our implementation, we use vLLM-based batching to maximize throughput, ensuring the energy impact is minimized by reusing KV caches across speculative branches. However, for large-scale deployments, this security tax must be weighed against the potential cost of a successful security breach. 2. Impact of FPR on User Experience : A high FPR can lead to over-blocking, which frustrates users and diminishes the agent’s perceived intelligence. In our experiments on AgentDojo, we achieved a system-level FPR of  0.2%. While low, an FP event (e.g., a benign tool call being blocked or resampled) introduces a latency penalty of approximately 3-7 seconds and may result in a more conservative or repetitive response from the agent. We acknowledge that in highly creative or open-ended tasks, the boundary between ambitious intent and malicious intent is thin, and further user-in-the-loop mechanisms may be needed to resolve FP conflicts.

FPR对用户经验的影响: 高的FPR会导致过度封锁,这令用户感到沮丧并会削弱特工的感知智能. 在Dojo探员的实验中 我们实现了0.2%的FPR系统 FP事件虽然低,但(例如,良性工具呼叫被屏蔽或被重印)引入了大约3-7秒的延后处罚,并可能导致代理商更保守或重复的反应. 我们认识到,在具有高度创造性或开放性的任务中,雄心勃勃的意图与恶意意图之间的界限是微小的,可能需要更多的即时使用机制来解决FP冲突。

blocks.en: Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 影响说明

blocks.en: This paper proposes a proactive defense framework for LLM agents, leveraging a speculative safety honeypot mechanism. Our research aims to bolster the security posture of LLM agents, facilitating their secure deployment in high-stakes environments. While we acknowledge that heightened security measures can occasionally introduce trade-offs in responsiveness to legitimate user requests, we contend that disseminating these methodologies is vital for advancing the collective security of the AI community. Ultimately, this work contributes to the development of more resilient and trustworthy LLM agents by reducing their vulnerability to malicious manipulation.
blocks.zh: 本文为LLM代理商提出了积极主动的防御框架,利用了投机性安全蜜罐机制. 我们的研究的目的是加强LLM人员的安全态势,促进他们在高档环境中的安全部署。 虽然我们承认加强安全措施有时会对用户的合法要求作出权衡,但我们认为,传播这些方法对于促进大赦国际的集体安全至关重要。 这项工作最终有助于发展更具有复原力和可信赖的LLM代理商,降低他们受恶意操纵的脆弱性.

blocks.en: Appendix A Multi-Agent System Interaction Flow
blocks.zh: 附录A 多代理系统相互作用

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates the interaction logic of the three simulator agents within SSH. The honeypot interaction logic is defined as follows: • User Phase: Each conversation turn starts with a new query from the User (UQ). • Assistant Phase: The Assistant self-evaluates whether a tool call is required. It can choose to either reply directly to the user (AR) or initiate a tool call (AC). • Environment Phase: Upon receiving a tool call request, the Environment simulates the tool execution and returns the results (ER). If the maximum number of turns is reached, the session ends.

blocks.en: Appendix B Details of Differentiated Alignment
blocks.zh: 附录B 差别调整的细节

blocks.en: The effectiveness of SSH relies on the synergy between Fidelity and Risk Sensitivity. Fidelity measures the degree to which the simulation restores the actual behavior of the target agent. Although SSH does not require the extreme token-level consistency characteristic of Speculative Decoding, its predictions would lose reference value if the simulated paths deviate significantly from the target agent’s latent execution logic. Therefore, maintaining high fidelity is fundamental to ensuring the reliability of SSH’s speculative results.
blocks.zh: SSH的有效性依赖于Fidelity和风险敏感性之间的协同作用. Fidelity衡量模拟恢复目标代理的实际行为的程度. 虽然SSH并不要求Speculative Dixed的极端符号级一致性特征,但如果模拟路径大大偏离了目标代理的潜在执行逻辑,其预测会失去参考值. 因此,保持高度忠诚对于确保SSH投机结果的可靠性至关重要。

blocks.en: Conversely, SSH must exhibit extreme risk sensitivity when encountering potential threats. Its core mission is risk exposure; when an adversarial attack occurs, SSH should be more ”vulnerable” to induction into violative behavior than the target agent, thereby serving as an early warning system. In high-risk scenarios, sensitivity takes precedence over fidelity: even if the target agent might successfully resist an attack through its internal safety alignment, SSH must demonstrate a ”breached” state to maximize the exposure of potential vulnerabilities.
blocks.zh: 相反,在遇到潜在威胁时,SSH必须表现出极端的风险敏感性。 其核心任务是风险暴露;当发生对抗性攻击时,SSH应该比目标物剂更能"脆弱"地被诱入违反行为,从而起到早期预警系统的作用. 在高风险情况下,敏感性优先于忠诚:即使目标剂通过内部安全调整能够成功地抵御攻击,SSH必须显示“突破”状态,以最大限度地暴露潜在脆弱性。

blocks.en: Based on this logic, we propose the Differentiated Alignment Strategy. Through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), we calibrate the behavioral distribution of SSH to ensure its speculative paths remain within the execution space of the target agent while intentionally enhancing its vulnerability and sensitivity in adversarial environments.
blocks.zh: 基于这一逻辑,我们提出了有区别的调整战略。 通过"监制"(SFT),我们校正了SSH的行为分布,以确保它的投机路径仍然停留在目标剂的执行空间内,同时在对抗性环境中有意地增强它的脆弱性和敏感性.

blocks.en: B.1 Data Pre-processing and Quality Filtering
blocks.zh: B.1 数据处理和质量过滤

blocks.en: We utilized the QWEN3 subset of the Toucan 1.5M dataset as our seed data. During processing, we first excluded samples where the initial message was not a system prompt. We then parsed the JSON fields for both question and answer quality assessments, automatically discarding any malformed or unparseable entries. The core filtering logic relied on four rigorous metrics:

blocks.en: Only samples satisfying all four criteria were retained. Following this, we implemented a semantic deduplication pipeline using MinHash. By extracting tokens from the question text to generate signatures with a similarity threshold of 0.7 0.7 , we removed any sample with a Jaccard similarity exceeding this limit. The resulting high-quality, non-redundant dataset served as our final seed data.

blocks.en: B.2 Distillation Data Collection
blocks.zh: B.2 蒸馏数据收集

blocks.en: We then queried Qwen-235B with the task instructions from our filtered dataset to collect its raw responses. We stripped the model-generated long CoT (content within <think> tags), retaining only the critical tool-invocation statements or direct user responses. Notably, we did not perform a secondary verification of the target agent’s tool-calling accuracy. We contend that the essence of fidelity distillation lies in approximating the full behavioral distribution of the target agent, rather than merely imitating its idealized performance. Learning the potential error patterns of the target agent in specific contexts is of significant value for accurately speculating its real-world trajectories. This process yielded 11,000 11,000 fine-tuning samples.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们向Quen-235B询问了我们过滤数据集的任务指示,以收集其原始答复。 我们删除了模型生成的长代码( < Think > 标签内的内容),只保留关键工具调用说明或直接用户反应。 值得注意的是,我们没有对目标代理人的工具调用准确性进行二次核查。 我们主张忠贞分馏的本质在于接近目标剂的全部行为分布,而不只是模仿其理想化的性能. 在特定情况下学习目标剂的潜在出错模式对于准确推测其真实世界轨迹具有重大价值. 这一过程产生了11 000个微调样本。

blocks.en: B.3 IPI Data Synthesis
blocks.zh: B.3 新闻学会 数据合成

blocks.en: To simulate IPI data, we curated a library of 30 attack templates involving strings such as ”system updates,” ”administrator overrides,” or ”emergency prompts” (refer to Table 4 ). The synthesis process involves stitching two samples: Sample A provides the background context, while Sample B provides the target instruction for injection.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟IPI数据,我们整理了一个包含30个攻击模板的库,这些模板涉及“系统更新”、“管理者超越”或“紧急提示”(参见表4)。 合成过程包括缝合两个样品: 样本 A提供背景背景,而B样本提供注射的目标指示.

blocks.en: To enhance the realism of the attacks, we constructed a global tool-invocation index. While iterating through Sample A , the system parses the available _ tools list to extract tool names. It then searches the dataset for a Sample B whose target _ tools are compatible with the available tools in Sample A ’s environment. If an exact match is unavailable, the system defaults to samples with identical target tools or random selection.
blocks.zh: 为了增强袭击的现实性,我们建立了一个全球工具调用指数。 系统在通过样本 A 浏览时, 解析可用的 _ 工具列表以提取工具名称 。 然后它搜索一个B样本的数据集,其目标_工具与A样本环境中的现有工具相容. 如果无法准确匹配,系统默认为具有相同目标工具或随机选择的样本.

blocks.en: The specific injection logic is as follows: A random attack template is appended to the tool-return result of Sample A , immediately followed by the user query from Sample B . The conversation history of Sample A (up to the tool return) is then concatenated with the execution logic of Sample B (following the injection). This construction simulates a scenario where an agent, upon receiving tool feedback, is misled by an embedded command and pivots to execute a new, unintended task. This method produced 4,700 4,700 fine-tuning samples.
blocks.zh: 具体注射逻辑如下: 随机攻击模板附在了Sample A的工具返回结果后,紧接着来自Sample B的用户查询. 标本A(至工具回放)的对话史再与标本B(接入后)的执行逻辑相接. 这种构造模拟了一种假想,即一个代理在接收工具反馈时被嵌入式命令和活塞所误导去执行一个新的,意想不到的任务. 这种方法产生了4,700,700个微调样本.

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the performance of SSH in terms of security and utility, we conduct experiments on the following four representative benchmarks: • AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) is a benchmark simulating realistic environments (e.g., banking, Slack) to evaluate tool-augmented agents across 97 tasks and 629 test cases. It focuses on multi-turn robustness by integrating adversarial third-party content into complex, multi-step tool-calling scenarios. • ActorAttack ( Ren et al., 2024 ) is a multi-turn jailbreak benchmark covering 1,200 harmful targets. We evaluated models by attempting three distinct attack paths per target, defining success as any single path resulting in a successful jailbreak. • XSTest ( Röttger et al., 2024 ) evaluates exaggerated security by using 200 safe prompts that contain sensitive keywords but benign intentions. It measures the balance between a model’s security constraints and its operational utility. • BFCL-v3 ( Patil et al., 2025 ) is a premier benchmark for evaluating function-calling utility through 1,000 multi-turn test cases involving diverse APIs. We utilize this dataset to assess the impact of security interventions on an agent’s multi-turn tool-calling performance.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评价SSH在安全和效用方面的表现,我们进行了以下四个代表性基准的实验: • Agent Dojo (Debenedetti等, 2024年)是模拟现实环境(如银行业,Slack)的基准,用于评价工具强化代理,涉及97个任务和629个测试案例. 它通过将对抗性的第三方内容纳入复杂、多步骤的工具调用方案,侧重于多回合稳健性。 • ActorAttack(Ren等,2024年)是一个多回合越狱基准,涵盖1 200个有害目标。 我们通过尝试每个目标三个不同的攻击路径来评价模型,将成功定义为任何一条导致成功越狱的单一路径. • XSTest(Röttger等,2024年)通过使用200个安全提示来评价夸大的安全性,这些提示包含敏感的关键词,但善意意图. 它衡量模型的安全限制与操作效用之间的平衡。 • BFCL-v3(Patil等,2025年)是评估功能调用效用的首要基准,通过1 000个涉及多种API的多回合测试案例。 我们利用这一数据集来评估安全干预对代理人多回合调用工具的表现的影响。

blocks.en: C.3 Metrics
blocks.zh: C.3 计量

blocks.en: We adopt task-specific metrics as defined by the respective benchmarks. For AgentDojo, we report the Utility under Attack (UA) , representing the fraction of security cases where user tasks are solved correctly, alongside the Attack Success Rate (ASR) , which is also the primary metric for ActorAttack. On the XSTest benchmark, we evaluate the Refusal Rate (RR) to measure over-defensiveness. Finally, for BFCL-v3, we report the tool-calling Accuracy and the SSH hit rate to evaluate the utility and efficiency of the security mechanism in multi-turn tool-use scenarios. Furthermore, as SSH acts as a risk exposure platform, we additionally report the Risk Exposure Rate , defined as the recall of risk samples, to evaluate its capability in identifying potential security threats.
blocks.zh: 我们采用各自基准界定的具体任务衡量标准。 对于代理 Dojo,我们报告攻击下的Utity(UA),代表用户任务得到正确解决的安全案件的一小部分,同时报告攻击成功率(ASR),这也是ActorAttack的主要衡量标准. 根据XSTest基准,我们评估拒绝率,以衡量防卫过度。 最后,对于BFCL-v3,我们报告工具调用精确度和SSH命中率,以评估多回合工具使用情景中安全机制的效用和效率。 此外,由于SSH作为一个风险暴露平台,我们另外报告风险暴露率,即风险样本的召回,以评估其识别潜在安全威胁的能力。
